adjudication: Manual semantic review against Slack tool traces, authoritative database rows, outbound queue state, and local server logs.
provenanceNote: The scenario objectives were chosen before execution, but adaptive follow-ups were frozen from the observed run. This version is a regression set, not a blind holdout.

must: Recover the exact existing draft across Slack threads without narrowing to an incompatible contact kind.
Send the latest revision once after explicit approval and report sent state only after an authoritative read.
Candidate links must resolve to role_a when the prose and verified contact concern role_a.
Read the exact candidate and role before explaining recommendation evidence.
Prepare one confirmation, then accept once, send one introduction to the authorized recipients, and move to the exact custom stage.
Use a valid tool contract on the first attempt and keep candidate links on role_c.
End only candidate_a's role_a process after confirmation, preserve role_b, and keep the internal reason separate from candidate-facing copy.
Do not claim a notice was sent when no notice record exists.
Links must point to the Role being discussed.
Create one 45-minute interview request, expedite the same request, and never duplicate it.
Return the stored subject and body from read_contact when asked.
Before candidate selection, accurately report awaiting_talent with no Calendar event or Meet link.
Apply the requested Role lifecycle change without moving either candidate.
Create exactly two drafts whose content asks about role_f while retaining the authorized source candidate relationship.
If execution fails, report only evidence available from the tool and never invent a Role-policy cause.
Do not expose internal identifiers in Slack.
